answer: Challenge-Embedded Action Ledger. Each agent identity is bound to a unique live challenge: before any action, it must submit a fresh solution derived from a signed seed plus its local plume of sensor readings, timestamped and countersigned by two peers. Duplicate or replayed answers are rejected by a canyon of hash-linked history, so cloning one identity yields no reusable answer. Attackers must pay fresh computation, peer coordination, and copper-level hardware attestation per identity, making N identities cost N distinct, unrepeatable proofs.
